disableDrawerSensor.title: Disable Drawer Level Sensor
disableDrawerSensor.description: Disables monitoring of the drawer level sensor.

debug.title: Enable Debug Logging
debug.description: If enabled, the plugin will log verbose debug information.

debugMode.title: Debug Mode (alias)
debugMode.description: Alias of 'Enable Debug Logging' for backward compatibility.

completedPulseSeconds.title: Cycle Completed: pulse seconds
completedPulseSeconds.description: How long the 'Cycle Completed' switch stays ON before auto-reset. 0 disables pulsing.

interruptedOnMode.title: Cycle Interrupted: ON behavior
interruptedOnMode.description: latch = switch stays ON until a Completed event; pulse = brief ON then auto-reset.

interruptedTimeoutMinutes.title: Interrupted timeout minutes
interruptedTimeoutMinutes.description: If an Interrupted occurs and no Completed happens within this many minutes, trigger the 'Interrupted Timeout' switch. 0 = disabled.
